statement: Let C(x) = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} |nums[i] - x|, with ordinary integer absolute value. The function returns a result r and r = min_{x is an integer} C(x).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; and the minimum over all integers x of sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} |nums[i] - x| is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail (no panic, overflow, or out-of-bounds access).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), r <= sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} |nums[i] - nums[j]|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let lo = min_{0 <= i < len(nums)} nums[i] and hi = max_{0 <= i < len(nums)} nums[i]. The function returns a result r and r >= hi - lo.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an index k with 0 <= k < len(nums) such that r = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} |nums[i] - nums[k]|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let L(x) = #{i : 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] < x} and G(x) = #{i : 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] > x}. The function returns a result r and, for every integer x, r = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} |nums[i] - x| if and only if L(x) <= floor(len(nums)/2) and G(x) <= floor(len(nums)/2).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. For every slice ys of length len(nums) that is a permutation of nums (that is, ys has the same multiset of entries as nums), the function returns a result r_y on ys and r_y = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. Let neg(nums) be the slice of length len(nums) with neg(nums)[i] = -nums[i]. The function returns a result r_neg on neg(nums) and r_neg = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. For every integer c such that -10^9 <= nums[i] + c <= 10^9 for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), let shifted(nums,c) be the slice with shifted(nums,c)[i] = nums[i] + c. The function returns a result r_c on shifted(nums,c) and r_c = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. For every positive integer k such that -10^9 <= k*nums[i] <= 10^9 for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), let scaled(nums,k) be the slice with scaled(nums,k)[i] = k*nums[i]. The function returns a result r_k on scaled(nums,k) and r_k = k*r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; and for every i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums) and 0 <= j < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[j].

statement: The function returns a result r and r > 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; and there exist i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), and nums[i] != nums[j].

statement: Let sn be a nondecreasing rearrangement of nums and n = len(nums). The function returns a result r and r = sum_{i=0}^{floor(n/2)-1} (sn[n-1-i] - sn[i]).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.
